documento.sin_razon_social: Holder without a registered business name
documento.descripcion: Review what AgroFusion will receive for the producer over a range of closed periods, before it is transferred to accounting.
documento.nit_ayuda: Digits only, without the check digit.
documento.lo_que_recibe: This is exactly what AgroFusion receives with version {{version}} of the accounting contract.
documento.vacio_detalle: The range is closed but has no supplier invoices. AgroFusion will receive a valid empty document.

clientes.error_codigo: Use only uppercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter. Example: COGANAHUILA_INT.
clientes.error_client_id: Enter the identifier the system uses to request access.
clientes.error_canales: Select at least one thing the system can do.
clientes.error_limite: Requests per minute must be 1 or more.
clientes.error_ip: Enter a valid address with numbers from 0 to 255. Example: 203.0.113.10 or 203.0.113.0/24.
clientes.error_ttl: The duration must be between 5 and 60 minutes.
clientes.descripcion: External systems that can request access to the integration, their credential and what they can query.
clientes.rotar_aviso: The current credential stops working immediately. Coordinate the change with the AgroFusion team before confirming.
clientes.suspender_ayuda: {{cliente}} will not be able to query or request access until reactivated. Its current access stops working on the next request.
clientes.reactivar_ayuda: {{cliente}} can request access and query again.
clientes.revocar_ayuda: Revoking {{cliente}} is permanent and cannot be undone.
clientes.vacio_detalle: Register AgroFusion with the credential its team uses to connect.
clientes.codigo_ayuda: Uppercase letters, numbers and underscore. Example: AGROFUSION.
clientes.client_id_ayuda: The one the external system sends when requesting access.
clientes.secreto_propio_ayuda: If the external system already has a secret, type it here (16 to 72 characters). If left empty, a new one is generated.
clientes.ip_ayuda: Example: 203.0.113.10 or 203.0.113.0/24. Empty allows any origin.
clientes.secreto_aviso: Save the secret now and hand it to the AgroFusion team through a secure channel. It is not shown again.
clientes.revocado_explicacion: Permanently revoked: it cannot be reactivated. If you need it, register a new one.
clientes.error_motivo: Write the reason for the change (at least 3 characters).

canal_ayuda.CONSULTA_AAEF: Retrieves the producers' purchase invoices for accounting.
canal_ayuda.IDENTIDAD_M2M: Creates, queries and updates user accounts from AgroFusion.

contrato.aprobar_contador_ayuda: Once approved, the annex moves to “In review” and cannot go back to draft. The AgroFusion test is still pending. Explain why you approve it: it is kept in the audit log.
contrato.justificacion_ayuda: At least 20 characters. For example: “I checked the mapping against the producer’s chart of accounts”.
contrato.justificacion_corta: Write at least 20 characters to justify the approval.
contrato.activar_resumen: From now on AgroFusion will receive the document with version {{version}} (scheduled start: {{fecha}}).
contrato.activar_retira: These versions will be retired with a grace period: {{versiones}}.
contrato.activar_no_retira: No version is retired: it coexists with the active ones.
contrato.descripcion: Versions of the format delivered to AgroFusion and the annex that defines each field.
contrato.comprobante_apagado: For now only purchase invoices are sent. The IAS 41 voucher will be enabled once external accounting accepts it.
contrato.anexos_vacio_detalle: Register the annex with the document path and its SHA-256 fingerprint.
contrato.en_revision_listo: Annex approved by the Accountant; it is now under review.
contrato.aprobar_prueba_ayuda: Record the evidence of the TEST run: AgroFusion queried without error, it was transferred to accounting and accounting accepted every document.
contrato.id_intercambio_ayuda: The one AgroFusion showed in the test transfer.
contrato.ack: Accounting accepted every document of the test
contrato.ruta_ayuda: Where the formal annex document lives.
contrato.versiones_vacio_detalle: Without an active version, AgroFusion gets an error when it queries.
contrato.registrado_listo: Version {{version}} was registered as Pending. It activates on its effective date or when you activate it.
contrato.deprecar_ayuda: The version keeps responding during the notice period and is unavailable afterwards.
contrato.fecha_vigencia_ayuda: It activates on its own that day if it meets the conditions; you can also activate it earlier.
contrato.sin_anexo_aprobado: The Accountant must approve an annex first.
contrato.gracia: Notice period for the previous version (days)
contrato.gracia_ayuda: At least {{min}} days. Leave it empty to use {{defecto}}.
contrato.estandar: AAEF standard version: {{version}}. It is the one the external accounting system accepts and it does not change with the contract version.
contrato.inconsistente: Critical alert: inconsistent contract state. There are {{n}} versions in force at the same time ({{versiones}}) and only two are allowed.
contrato.inconsistente_detalle: No other version can be activated until it is fixed. Tell technical support so they retire the extra one.
contrato.quedan_dias_one: {{count}} day of the retirement period left
contrato.quedan_dias_other: {{count}} days of the retirement period left
contrato.retirada_explicacion: No longer available: a retired version cannot be reactivated or modified.
contrato.deprecado_listo: Version {{version}} is being retired: it answers until {{fecha}}.
contrato.deprecar_explicacion: Version {{version}} keeps answering during the period and stops being available on {{fecha}}. Retirement cannot be reverted.
contrato.version_ayuda: Use the major.minor format, for example 4.0.
contrato.error_version: Write the version in the major.minor format, for example 4.0.
contrato.error_mapeadores: Choose at least one document to send.
contrato.error_gracia_vacia: Write the retirement period in days.
contrato.error_gracia: The retirement period must be at least {{min}} days.
contrato.aviso_plazo: The field “Retirement period of the previous version” appeared; it is required for a major change (at least {{min}} days).
contrato.aviso_sin_plazo: A minor change does not retire the previous version: the “Retirement period” field was removed.
contrato.gracia_ayuda_requerida: Required for a major change. At least {{min}} days; {{defecto}} suggested.

tipo_cambio.MAJOR: Major change (retires the previous one with notice)
tipo_cambio.MINOR: Minor change (coexists with the previous one)

auditoria.titular_invalido: The tax ID must have 6 to 15 digits, without the check digit.
auditoria.descripcion: Everything that happened in the AgroFusion integration. No record can be changed and each one is verified when queried.
auditoria.descripcion_auditor: Accounting queries of closed periods and contract activations.
auditoria.vacio_detalle: There are no events with these filters.
auditoria.exportando: Generating the {{formato}} file of the audit…
auditoria.exportado: {{formato}} file ready: the audit was downloaded.
auditoria.alterados_titulo_one: Critical alert: {{count}} audit record was altered
auditoria.alterados_titulo_other: Critical alert: {{count}} audit records were altered
auditoria.alterados_detalle: Its integrity fingerprint no longer matches the stored one. Review the event and tell the security officer.

evento.PREPARACION_AAEF_FALLIDA: The accounting document could not be prepared
evento.CONTRATO_ACTIVACION_BLOQUEADA: A contract version could not be activated

resultado.RANGO_NO_ALINEADO: Range does not match the periods
resultado.MAPPER_FALLIDO: The document could not be built
resultado.LIMITE_VERSIONES_EXCEDIDO: No room for another active version
